title: reaction.chain_propagated
description: M15D § fires when a `propagates: true` reaction spreads from one pixel to an adjacent compatible neighbor — e.g. gunpowder + spark chain detonation, oil-fire cascade, contact freeze. Carries the reaction id, the origin pixel, the destination pixel, and the chain depth (0 for first ignition). Producer: cf-material reaction evaluator inside the propagation pass. Per acceptance scenario 5: 'reaction_chain_propagated fires for each adjacent gunpowder tile within 3 ticks'.
